home.heroSubtitle: Discover yoga studios near you, book classes instantly, and find your perfect practice — all in one place.
home.philosophyText: Yoga is more than poses on a mat. It's a journey of self-discovery, a community of kindred spirits, and a practice that meets you exactly where you are. At YogaHub, we believe everyone deserves access to that peace.
home.step1Desc: Browse yoga studios in your area. Filter by style, difficulty, and location.
home.step2Desc: Pick a session that fits your schedule. One click and you're in — no hassle.
home.step3Desc: Show up, roll out your mat, and enjoy. Leave a review to help others discover great studios.
home.forOwnersDesc: List your studio, manage class schedules, and reach more students — with fair pricing that respects small businesses.
home.exploreDesc: Whether you're a first-timer or an experienced practitioner, there's a class waiting for you.
home.noStudios: No studios yet. Be the first!
home.copyright: Built with 💚 for the yoga community.
